recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated image featuring two male figures walking along a rural roadside, framed by a distressed white border and anchored by heavy, western-style slab-serif typography in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures walking toward the viewer offset by a vanishing point perspective of the road
Heavy red-toned display type balanced against the dark silhouette of the primary figure
Secondary text enclosed in a geometric frame to establish hierarchy
Desaturated background emphasizing the textural details of the subjects' clothing
coreInvariants: Rough, hand-drawn white border with inner black vignette
Vanishing point perspective leading to the left
High-contrast black and white or sepia-toned photography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body figures positioned right-of-center, scaled to occupy 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched display typography in the top-left corner acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left text, follows the vertical line of the central figure, and moves down the receding road toward the horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky and the road surface provide open areas to prevent visual clutter around the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grayscale or muted sepia for the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and the primary figure's duster coat.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Desaturated brick red for the primary display lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subjects and the sky.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and grayscale

letterConstructionRules: Vertical compression with exaggerated horizontal serifs
Arched baseline for the top line of text
Distressed, weathered texture applied to the fill
Thin inner inline stroke following the letter contours

composition.relationshipToImage: contained in a rounded-corner rectangle frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A decorative, arched western face paired with a cleaner, framed geometric slab for clarity.
graphicDevices: Rounded-corner rectangular frame with double-line border

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the western spurred slab serif aesthetic
Good base for the framed subtitle text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, black and white photograph of two men in country attire (one in a cowboy hat and long black coat) walking along a rural road with a small town in the distant background. Apply a heavy vignette and a rough, hand-painted white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary text in an arched, weathered red slab-serif font in the top left. Below it, add the subtitle in a clean black slab-serif font inside a rounded-corner rectangular box.

verificationChecks: Is the image desaturated with high contrast?
Is there a distressed white border?
Is the subtitle enclosed in a frame?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red accent color
Amount of distressing on the border
Degree of the arch in the display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting between subjects and background
Ensure the arch of the text does not overlap the subjects' heads
Verify the texture on the text matches the grain of the photo
Confirm the border looks hand-applied rather than a digital filter
recipe.reuseFormula: Rural road perspective + High-contrast monochrome photography + Arched Western Slab-Serif + Distressed Frame
